text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
* The biggest prize ever was awarded in Portugal's Totoloto lottery -- 800 million escudos.
* President Jorge Sampaio stayed in close contact with Macau governor Rocha Vieira during his official visit to China.
* President Jorge Sampaio and Prime Minister Antonio Guterres are falling in popularity, according to a poll. However, the Portuguese still prefer to have the ruling Socialist Party in power.
* International prostitution ring uncovered in Viseu in central Portugal, the newspaper learned.
* Petrogal will boost its stake in Transgas from 4.6 percent to 19.6 percent for an investment of some 5.5 billion escudos.
* The government will inform Brussels today that it posted a budget deficit of four percent of GDP in 1996, Under-Secretary for Budget Manuela Arcanjo told the paper.
